items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: He was down to my house, trying to find something I had that hadn't already been put out by one of these people, but we couldn't find anything.

ctx.x: And I don't have all of them.
Wally Heider is putting out air checks -- no, not air checks, radio transcriptions, right? Isn't that what he has of yours?
I don't know. He was down to my house, trying to find something I had that hadn't already been put out by one of these people, but we couldn't find anything.
